runtime-enforcement.purpose: lock critical task decisions and require a passing deliverable receipt

execution-efficiency.purpose: finish evidence readiness, parallelize independent artifacts, and stabilize candidates before independent review

reader-validation.purpose: run four isolated reader reviews in parallel and block delivery until all pass

scenario-routing.purpose: select one primary reader task and a bounded secondary task when needed

output-standards.purpose: apply the eight cross-scenario output standards and hard gates

signal-processing.purpose: turn readability signals into context-tested revision decisions

diagnosis-and-revision.purpose: diagnose or revise an existing document without meaning drift

evaluation.purpose: score, compare, or regression-test high-risk outputs

format-decision.purpose: select the output format and apply the portable native-format presentation baseline

reading-path-layout.purpose: plan and verify the cross-section reading path, evidence adjacency, density rhythm, and spacing hierarchy of every finished artifact

html-output.purpose: select output format and render self-contained HTML or a portable native-format baseline

visual-decision.purpose: decide whether a material visual reduces reader cost before loading implementation detail

visual-communication.purpose: implement retained charts, diagrams, tables, color, and encoded layout faithfully

visual-evidence.purpose: verify visual provenance, identity, context, and synthetic disclosure

title-design.purpose: design or diagnose an evidence-faithful, information-bearing title

agent-portability.purpose: package, invoke, and regression-test the canonical skill across agent hosts

skill-maintenance.purpose: change the skill without duplicating routing rules or reducing retained capability

scenario-technical.purpose: technical proposal and architecture decision route

scenario-product.purpose: product introduction, launch note, and PRD route

scenario-business.purpose: business update, review, retrospective, and performance route

scenario-procedure.purpose: procedure, runbook, help article, and SOP route
